name: What should I prepare before meeting with a contractor about a kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before meeting with a contractor about a kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an initial kitchen layout consultation, compile a clear list of what currently frustrates you about your kitchen, such as inadequate counter space, poor lighting, or crowded walkways. Gather rough dimensions of the room, ceiling heights, and photos of structural posts or exterior walls. Note any appliances you plan to reuse versus replace, as appliance specifications dictate cabinet framing openings. Finally, establish a realistic budget range and identify non-negotiable functional priorities so your contractor can assess structural possibilities and mechanical boundaries realistically.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure rough room dimensions, list your current workflow pain points, note desired appliance sizes, and set a clear target budget for design and construction discussions.
